bead.title: claude-tui/step6: QuotaHarness implementation — consume shared anthropic quota snapshot
bead.description:
Implement QuotaStatus / RefreshQuota / QuotaFreshness / SupportedLimitIDs on claudetui.Runner.

CONTRACT: ADR-013 specifies both claude and claude-tui share the same durable cache under the single-account assumption. QuotaStatus reads the anthropic-package-owned snapshot mirror; RefreshQuota delegates the /usage PTY probe (already implemented for claude) through the anthropic package. claude-tui does not own a parallel quota probe.

The routehealth.RefreshScheduler will drive RefreshQuota automatically via QuotaFreshness().
bead.acceptance:
1) QuotaStatus returns the same data the claude harness's QuotaStatus returns when given the same cache state — verified by a side-by-side test using harnesstest synthetics.
2) SupportedLimitIDs returns the same set as claude's SupportedLimitIDs (same Anthropic /usage window taxonomy).
3) RefreshQuota performs a /usage PTY probe (via the shared probe machinery in anthropic/) and persists the result to the shared cache.
4) Cache contention test: claude.Runner.RefreshQuota and claudetui.Runner.RefreshQuota called concurrently coalesce to a single PTY probe via single-flight; verified by counting probe invocations in a test double.
5) Cassette evidence for the /usage probe: a record-mode test (build tag harness_integration) against an authenticated claude binary records /usage frames into a cassette at internal/harnesses/claude-tui/testdata/quota_probe/; a replay-mode test (default CI) reads the cassette and verifies the parsed QuotaStatus matches expected shape.
6) QuotaFreshness returns a positive duration matching ADR-013's documented value (recommend 15 minutes default to match claude).
7) Conformance suite passes; routehealth.RefreshScheduler schedules claude-tui refreshes without modification — verified by a service-level test that observes scheduler-driven refresh calls hitting claude-tui.
8) go test ./internal/harnesses/claude-tui/... -count=1 green.
